title: Role of Cre Dynamics in Autoinhibition and Priming.
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过100微秒分子动力学模拟研究自由态Cre重组酶的构象动态，揭示其自抑制与预激活机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作（Cre-loxP体系）的动态结合机理建模，方法为MD模拟，高度契合TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: Cre recombinase, a powerful tool for genome engineering, associates into an intasome, a tetrameric complex of alternate active and inactive monomers that bring together two loxP sequences, stabilized by key protein-protein and protein-DNA interactions. High-resolution structural information for free Cre is still missing, in contrast to the many structures found for Cre-DNA complexes in the Protein Data Bank, hindering understanding of the initial steps in intasome formation. To approach Cre structure and dynamics, we carried out 100 mus of molecular dynamics simulations of free Cre, starting from five Cre structures from different stages of intasome assembly. In the generated ensemble, the linker connecting the CBD and CAT domains is an intrinsically disordered region (IDR) that promotes different orientations of the two domains. The domains remain folded and interact with each other through short-lived interactions, retaining  approximately 70% of their surface available for interaction with loxP. The C-terminal Helix N in the CAT domain is also an IDR that interacts with the entire protein, including the active site, transiently forming an autoinhibited complex. The active site can be assembled in the absence of DNA, albeit inefficiently. The CAT domain has a clam-like motion, opening and closing the cavity where helix N docks, establishing protein-protein interactions in the intasome. Helix A in the CBD domain slides over the domain like a windshield wiper, sampling intasome-like conformations, among others. The wide range of intramolecular motion sampled by free Cre suggests that it uses conformational selection, using primed DNA-binding surfaces in both domains while assembling into the intasome.
abstract_zh: Cre重组酶是基因组工程的有力工具，其组装成内含体（intasome），这是一种由交替活性和非活性单体组成的四聚体复合物，将两个loxP序列聚集在一起，并通过关键的蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-DNA相互作用得以稳定。与蛋白质数据银行（Protein Data Bank）中发现的许多Cre-DNA复合物结构相比，游离Cre的高分辨率结构信息仍然缺失，这阻碍了对内含体形成初始步骤的理解。为探究Cre的结构和动态，我们进行了100微秒的游离Cre分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，起始于内含体组装不同阶段的五个Cre结构。在生成的集合中，连接CBD和CAT结构域的连接区是一个内在无序区域（intrinsically disordered region, IDR），促进两个结构域的不同取向。这些结构域保持折叠状态，并通过短暂相互作用彼此接触，保留约70%的表面可供与loxP相互作用。CAT结构域中的C端螺旋N也是一个内在无序区域，与整个蛋白质（包括活性位点）相互作用，瞬时形成自抑制复合物。活性位点可在无DNA情况下组装，尽管效率较低。CAT结构域具有类似蛤壳的运动，打开和关闭螺旋N停靠的腔体，在内含体中建立蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。CBD结构域中的螺旋A像雨刷器一样在结构域上滑动，采样内含体样构象等。游离Cre采样的广泛分子内运动表明，它利用构象选择，在组装成内含体时使用两个结构域中预激活的DNA结合表面。
